description: This Java test class verifies the functionality of the ScriptedIncomingMapping component, particularly its ability to map ExternalMessage objects to native JavaScript objects and produce protocol messages via embedded JavaScript scripts. It includes tests for mapping message payloads and executing JavaScript code to generate protocol messages.

classes.name: ScriptedIncomingMappingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the JavaScript-based incoming message mapping functionality, including payload conversion and script execution for protocol message creation.

methods.name: mapExternalMessage
methods.description: Helper method to verify that a ByteBuffer is correctly mapped to a NativeObject with expected byte payload.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageFromReadOnlyBuffer
methods.description: Test to verify mapping from a read-only ByteBuffer source.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageTextAndBytes
methods.description: Test that verifies mapping of an ExternalMessage with both text and byte payloads to a native JavaScript object.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageProducingArrayOfDittoProtocolMessages
methods.description: Test that executes JavaScript code to produce an array of Ditto protocol messages and verifies their content.

methods.name: testJavascript
methods.description: Utility method that sets up a Rhino JavaScript environment, loads required scripts, evaluates the provided script, and verifies the resulting Adaptables.
